title: We Did It! A Milestone Achievement at Arab African International Bank
subtitle: Arab African International Bank (AAIB)
description:
🏆 We Did It! A Milestone Achievement at Arab African International Bank

I am incredibly proud and thrilled to announce the successful official launch of the new Arab African International Bank (AAIB) website!

This journey has been long, filled with challenges, learning, and intensive teamwork. Seeing this massive project come to fruition makes every single step worthwhile. This project truly exemplifies what great collaboration can accomplish.

🙏 Acknowledgments and Gratitude
A huge thank you to the entire team for your efforts. A special shoutout to Ahmed Anwar, Mahmoud Elkordy, Kareem El-Tayeb, Ahmed Al Tohamy, Ali Maher, Ashraf Hussein, Dina Ashraf ElRefaai, Arafa Masry, Abdelkhalek Selim, and Yahiya Ramadan — your commitment and attention to detail made a real difference.

Special thanks also to Passant Helmy for your outstanding support and dedication throughout the project.

And for sure this achievement can't be done without the undeniable support, guidance and motivation of our heads: Reda Drehim, Yara Medhat Ph.D.

It has been an honor to be part of this project, and I am grateful to everyone who contributed to this major achievement.

🚀 On to the Next Chapter
Here's to more success and achievements together! On to the next milestone!

title: Excited to share a new milestone with the incredible team at Mahaseel!
subtitle: Mahaseel
description:
Excited to share a new milestone with the incredible team at Mahaseel!

I'm proud to be part of the talented team behind Mahaseel Trace, our digital traceability platform designed to bring transparency and trust to the agricultural supply chain.

We've just completed a successful training session with the Egyptian Food Bank, showcasing how Mahaseel Trace enables end-to-end tracking to the final consumer.

It's truly rewarding to see our efforts creating real impact on the ground. Looking forward to the next chapter as we continue driving innovation in agri-tech!

#Mahaseel #MahaseelTrace #DigitalAgriculture #Traceability #AgriTech #FoodSecurity #DigitalTransformation #Teamwork #ProudMoment

title: Software Engineer intern at Orange Digital Center Egypt
subtitle: Orange Digital Center Egypt
description:

Their unwavering support and guidance have been invaluable, and I have learned so much during my time here. Meeting everyone and learning from their experiences has been an enriching experience, and I am excited to continue on this journey.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Hassan Daboos, and all my colleagues for their constant support and encouragement throughout my internship. Your guidance has played a significant role in shaping my growth as a software engineer.

I would like to thank everyone who has made my time here such a memorable and rewarding experience. Being a part of this team has been an honor, and I look forward to continuing to learn and grow with all of you.
